purpose.en: Stretch your chest and the fronts of your shoulders.

text.zh: 双前臂贴住门框，身体慢慢往前穿过门口
text.en: Rest both forearms on the frame and lean gently through the doorway
Stand with one foot ahead and keep your feet still.

text.zh: 胸口有拉伸感就停，保持呼吸。
text.en: Stop when your chest stretches, and keep breathing.

commonErrors.zh: 腰往前挺代替打开胸口
commonErrors.en: Pushing the lower back forward instead of opening the chest.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时放松，只拉到舒服的程度
cautions.en: If anything hurts, ease off and stretch only to a comfortable point.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹着疼时，缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

changes: 动画是 8 秒 1 次「前倾-停 3.4 s-回来」在重复，剂量从 30 秒保持改为 2 组×6 次（rep_hold），dose mode hold→reps
名字「胸肌」改「胸部」；cautions 改「X 时 Y」
flags: 原为 30 秒静态拉伸，现按动画改为计次（每次只停约 3.4 s）；若要长时间静态保持需改动画或改回计时，请定
